title: Unique Paths
description: Find the number of unique paths to reach the bottom-right corner of an m x n grid.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize grid[m][n] with 1s
2. for i from 1 to m-1:
3.   for j from 1 to n-1:
4.     grid[i][j] = grid[i-1][j] + grid[i][j-1]
5. return grid[m-1][n-1]

steps.note: Initialize a 2x3 grid with 1s representing base cases.
Calculate paths for grid[1][1] = grid[0][1] + grid[1][0] = 1 + 1 = 2.
Calculate paths for grid[1][2] = grid[0][2] + grid[1][1] = 1 + 2 = 3.
Return the value at bottom-right corner: 3.
